name: player_restore_third_person_camera_from_obstruction_state
description: Player::RestoreThirdPersonCameraFromObstructionState copies the active camera world position into player cameraTarget and restores cameraDir from the cached obstruction direction.

The native smoke verifies cameraTarget is populated through gwNode::GetWorldPosition and cameraDir is restored from cameraObstructionDir.
